method: Read-only LinkedIn Chrome UI via CUA. Source body read from article.innerText after the displayed time. No direct LinkedIn network requests. No LinkedIn writes.

source: Take article.innerText, remove the prefix through its time element text.
For csvpf only, remove the image control text İçerik kimlik bilgilerine bakın.
local: Take Markdown text after the first newline + --- + newline metadata/body boundary.
Replace inline Markdown links matching \[([^\]]*)\]\([^\n]*?\) with captured label.

Before removing emphasis markers, remove start-of-line heading markers #{1,6} + space, quote markers > + space, bullet markers - + space, ordered list markers digits + dot + space, and standalone --- separator lines. Bold-numbered body paragraphs (e.g. **1. Defekti...) keep their numeric source text.
Remove * emphasis markers. No literal asterisks occur in these source bodies.
Remove all whitespace via Python re.sub(r"\s+", "", text).
normalization.checksum: FNV-1a 32-bit over each normalized UTF-16 code unit; initial 2166136261; for each unit XOR then multiply by 16777619 modulo 2^32. Length is UTF-16 code units. This validates text including punctuation with whitespace/Markdown representation excluded, not image contents or byte-identical HTML.
